name: Alliance Integrated Metaliks Limited
about: Alliance Integrated Metaliks Limited engages in the power ancillary equipment and engineering fabrication businesses in India. It offers fabrication and supply of heavy steel superstructures and equipment for steel bridges for rail, road, metro, DFCC, and expressways; foot over bridges; high rise buildings; thermal power plants; marine equipment requirements; stadiums and exhibition halls; airport superstructures; refineries; commercial buildings; and automobile plants. The company is also involved in designing, detailing engineering, manufacturing, finishing, and erection and handover for heavy fabrication activities. It serves government and private sector companies. The company was formerly known as B. S. Holdings and Credit Limited and changed its name to Alliance Integrated Metaliks Limited in 2004. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in New Delhi, India. Alliance Integrated Metaliks Limited operates as a subsidiary of WLD Investments Private Limited.
